name: Mozzarella & Prosciutto Stuffed Pita with Italian Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince onion. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Slice mozzarella into rounds. Place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear prosciutto into bite sized pieces. Add to the plate with the mozzarella.
Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets. Spread mayo on the inside of the pitas, then fill with mozzarella, prosciutto, and a small portion of salad. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Divide pitas between plates and serve with remaining salad on the side. Enjoy!
